_purpose: Published usage rules of every host the keep-current subsystem contacts, and the limits fetchkit.RateGovernor enforces for each. published_rule is quoted verbatim from source_url, or reads 'none published' with the date it was checked — never invented. Enforced limits sit at or below the published rule. A robots.txt Disallow may be overridden ONLY through documented_api_paths, and only with both citations (the robots line and the issuer's API documentation). Written only via tools/registry_io.py; tools/fetch_census.py --check fails CI when the monthly plan would exceed a run_cap.

ncp.nist.gov.published_rule: The META file should be used to determine if a given feed has been updated since your last import. This helps prevent unnecessary downloads of the .zip or .gz files and should result in a reasonable use of less than 200 requests per day.
ncp.nist.gov.probe: text of the top-level data-feeds route component in the NCP site bundle (the site is a JavaScript app); the same page states the .meta files are 'updated approximately every two hours'
ncp.nist.gov.robots: 200 text/html (the app shell, not a robots file) -> no rules
